set.body: Root eco-u4-integrations audit identified generic SoftLda and AlderSoftLda still in ScalaFIM, plus HeldOutSubjectPrediction and SubjectPredictiveSummary. Move soft LDA into mvpa4s-predictive and subject prediction into mvpa4s.pattern core, with tests. Preserve all audit/schema/hash framing, numeric oracles, feature-axis refusal, scientific unavailability and exposure accounting. Replace accidental Root error/writer dependencies with provider-owned contracts. No actual fMRI fit/group/archive interpretation moves. Acceptance: core/predictive+consumer JVM/JS, actual Root workflow scenarios, independent review.
set.title: Move remaining reusable predictive and subject-summary contracts upstream
